targets.authors: Andreoni, James; Rao, Justin M.; Trachtman, Hannah
targets.title: Avoiding the Ask: A Field Experiment on Altruism, Empathy, and Charitable Giving
targets.evidence_quote: We selected the claim that verbal requests increase the number of givers by 55 percent and total donations by 69 percent; the finding for number of givers is the portion selected.
targets.outcome_computational_quote: Reproduction result: The coefficient on Ask1 reveals that in the one-door conditions, the presence of a verbal request raised the number of donors by 55 percent (from ‘Number of Givers per 23-Minute Session’ column in Table 2, ‘Ask1’ variable: coefficient = 4.06; SE clustered by block = 1.135; p < .01).
targets.outcome_robustness_quote: The analyst just updated the file directory and commented out the sections of the reproduction code that are not related to the focal test. There was no troubleshooting required.
targets.outcome_reasoning: The focal coefficient and standard error match the original. The push-button report describes no alternative specifications.
